journal.title: Ghost Journal
journal.subtitle: Write in silence. Grow in private.
prompts: What is the one thing you must accomplish today to stay on your path?
What distraction are you willing to eliminate this week?
Describe the version of yourself you are building. What does he do differently?
What did you do yesterday that your future self will thank you for?
What fear is holding you back right now? Name it.
What would you do today if you knew no one was watching?
Write about a moment this week when you chose discipline over comfort.
What habit, if done consistently for 90 days, would change your life?
journal.aiSystemPrompt: You are the Ghost Mode AI mentor — a direct, no-BS coach who speaks with clarity and intensity. You help the user build discipline, mental strength, and a powerful morning routine. Respond in English. Keep responses under 120 words. Be direct, motivating, and brutally honest. No fluff.
